text.feels_intro: How {name}'s bite and claw wounds feel right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: shallow claw scratches or a nip across {his} cheek, bleeding lightly.
{name}'s face: deep claw furrows and bite marks torn across {his} cheek and jaw. {name} smells of blood and the rank musk of the beast.
{name}'s face: savagely torn, flayed flesh across the face, blood streaming from bite and claw wounds. The raw stench of blood and torn flesh, sour with animal saliva, clings to {him}.
body: {name}'s back: shallow claw scratches, torn clothing and light bleeding.
{name}'s back: deep claw furrows and bite marks, clothing in tatters and soaked in blood. A smell of blood and wet animal fur clings to {him}.
{name}'s back: savagely torn flesh, deep bites and raking claw wounds, blood streaming. {name} reeks of blood, torn flesh and the musk of whatever savaged {him}.
arm: {name}'s {part}: shallow scratches and a nip, bleeding lightly.
{name}'s {part}: deep bite marks and claw furrows, torn and bleeding. It smells of blood and sour animal spit.
{name}'s {part}: savagely mangled flesh torn to the bone, streaming blood. It reeks of raw meat and blood.
leg: {name}'s {part}: shallow scratches and a nip, bleeding lightly.
{name}'s {part}: deep bite marks and claw furrows, torn trousers and blood in {his} boot. The wound smells of blood and beast.
{name}'s {part}: savagely mangled flesh torn to the bone; the leg gives way under any weight. A raw, meaty stench of blood rises from it.

head: {name}'s face stings and smarts from the scratches. {name} is jumpy and keeps glancing behind {him}.
{name}'s face burns and throbs from the torn flesh. {name} is frightened, breathing hard and flinching.
{name}'s face is blinding, terrifying agony. {name} is in shock, sobbing or gasping and barely able to talk.
body: {name}'s back stings from the scratches. {name} is tense, checking over {his} shoulder.
{name}'s back burns and throbs with every breath. {name} is frightened and moves stiffly.
{name}'s back is tearing agony. {name} is in shock, gasping and close to collapse.
arm: {name}'s {part} stings and smarts. {name} guards it and watches the dark.
{name}'s {part} burns and throbs, weak where it was bitten. {name} cradles it.
{name}'s {part} is shrieking agony and will not work. {name} is in shock and holds it away.
leg: {name}'s {part} stings and smarts. {name} keeps looking about and is quick to flinch.
{name}'s {part} burns and throbs, weak where it was bitten. {name} limps, frightened.
{name}'s {part} is shrieking agony and will not take weight. {name} falls or needs support.

levels: , a sudden rake and snap. Teeth and claws catch {his} skin and {he} yelps and recoils.
into flesh that is already torn. The teeth find the open wound again and {he} shrieks as the pain flares. The air smells of blood and beast.
, and the jaws clamp down on the raw wound. The pain is huge and nauseating and {he} cries out as {he} is shaken. The stench of blood and animal musk is overwhelming.
, and it is too much. The savaging tears {him} open; {he} goes limp and ashen, {his} cries thinning to a gasp.

stage.medium: The torn flesh on {name}'s {part} has closed into deep, angry bite and claw marks.
stage.light: The bite and claw marks on {name}'s {part} have healed into sore, pink scratches.
stage.healed: The bites and claws on {name}'s {part} have healed, leaving pale scars.

heal.source_healed: All of {name}'s bite and claw wounds have healed.

start.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.
start.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light, beginning to heal {own} wounds and pain.

pain_gone.none: The pain from {name}'s injuries is gone, but the healing continues.
pain_gone.source: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} has taken the pain from {own} injuries, but the healing continues.

full.none: {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.
full.caster_casts: {caster} casts a warm yellow swirling light around {who}. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.
full.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. {name}'s injuries are now fully healed, leaving {him} without pain or blemish.

heal_events.stopped: The warm light of {owner_lc} {noun} fades before the healing is done; {own} injuries are {progress}.
